applied.fact: Pin 8 is the area's reference coordinate ~22 m from the summit pin, with no elevation or note: a duplicate summit
Traverse order is Red Ledges, Spider-Formidable Col, then Yang-Yang Lakes; the two mileages followed the wrong order and no source states them

waypoints.name: SR 20 / State Creek Pullout
waypoints.note: Same unsigned SR 20 pullout used for the South Buttress, ~1.5 mi west of Washington Pass (~0.5 mi west of the Blue Lake trailhead).
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the broad shoulder about half a mile west of the Blue Lake Trailhead — roughly a mile and a half west of Washington Pass — where there is room to park and a view through the trees to the peak. It is unsigned and sits near 5,050 ft, so measure from Blue Lake rather than looking for a marker. If you are meeting partners, the usual arrangement is to gather at the Blue Lake lot and then drive the short distance west to this pullout.

waypoints.name: State Creek crossing
waypoints.note: Cross State Creek in the forest below the pullout before climbing into the meadows/basin southwest of the summit.

waypoints.name: Basin below Whistler Mountain
waypoints.note: Trail runs along the north side of the drainage and flattens through the open basin around 6200 ft before angling up toward Cutthroat's southwest side.

waypoints.name: Southwest Gully entrance
waypoints.note: Talus/scree/sand gully gaining the ridge; in poor visibility parties have mistaken this for the steeper, harder Second Southwest Gully just to the right.

waypoints.name: Crux face above rap station
waypoints.note: A short 5.2 face above a double-bolt belay/rappel anchor leads to easy ledges below the ridge crest; rock is loose in spots.

waypoints.name: West Ridge crest / notch
waypoints.note: Gain the ridge crest here at a notch giving access toward the north ridge; narrow, exposed catwalk over a series of crestline horns.

waypoints.name: Northwest face traverse (Northwest Ledge)
waypoints.note: Exposed, near-two-rope-length traverse across the northwest face on the ledge finish to reach the north ridge below the summit block.

waypoints.name: Cutthroat Peak summit
waypoints.note: Final low-5th-class pitch/scramble tops out on the blocky true summit; reverse the ridge with downclimbing and short rappels to descend.

waypoints.name: West Ridge base / area reference point
Cascade Pass Trailhead (end of Cascade River Road)
waypoints.note: Also the standard trailhead for the reverse Ptarmigan Traverse exit at Downey Creek is different (Suiattle River Rd), but Cascade Pass is the traditional/most common starting trailhead.

waypoints.name: Cascade Pass
waypoints.note: Maintained trail ends here; traverse continues cross-country.

waypoints.name: Cache Col
waypoints.note: Glacier-travel notch south of Cascade Pass; gateway to the traverse proper.

waypoints.name: Kool-Aid Lake
waypoints.note: First bivy; the exposed 'Red Ledges' traverse below Art's Knoll follows.

waypoints.name: Red Ledges (Art's Knoll)
waypoints.note: Narrow, exposed ledge crossing; a fall here would be serious.

waypoints.name: Yang-Yang Lakes
waypoints.note: Second common bivy, below Spider-Formidable Col.

waypoints.name: Spider-Formidable Col
waypoints.note: High col crossing toward the LeConte Glacier and Sentinel/Old Guard Peaks.

waypoints.name: White Rock Lakes / South Cascade Glacier Col
waypoints.note: Third bivy; reached off the south end of the South Cascade Glacier, with the Dana Glacier leading on toward Spire Point.

waypoints.name: Spire Point
waypoints.note: Prominent landmark near the Dome-Dana col.

waypoints.name: Cub Lake / Itswoot Ridge
waypoints.note: Fourth bivy on Itswoot Ridge above Cub and Itswoot Lakes.

waypoints.name: Dome Peak
waypoints.note: Optional side summit near the traverse's south end; the traverse itself does not cross it.
